title: Thermalex Inc
description: Thermalex specializes in aluminum extrusion solutions, offering high-efficiency and corrosion-resistant products since 1985. Based in Montgomery, Alabama, the company serves various industries including HVAC, automotive, battery cooling, and industrial applications. With advanced manufacturing systems and a commitment to quality, Thermalex is recognized as a global leader in the aluminum extrusion industry. Their expertise includes the fabrication of microchannel tubes and complex extrusions tailored to meet diverse client needs.
